rows.description: A list of the sites (Standorte) of the Informationsverbund and whether each is visited in the respective audit.

Standort.description: The site as documented in the Strukturanalyse, e.g. 'Rechenzentrum Frankfurt (RZ-01)'.

Erst- bzw. Rezertifizierung.description: Whether this site is audited during the initial or re-certification audit.

1. Überwachungsaudit.description: Whether this site is audited during the first surveillance audit.

2. Überwachungsaudit.description: Whether this site is audited during the second surveillance audit.

Begründung für die Auswahl.description: The risk-based justification for auditing (or not auditing) this specific site.
